headline: Yongjiehi Shi jumps from 454th to 87th on ARC-3

sections.text: Yongjiehi Shi gained 2.73 points to reach 33.78, moving from 454th to 87th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The gain brings Yongjiehi Shi into the top 100 from outside the top 500 a day earlier.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
